source_refs.note: Functions of the Lymphatic System: a main subheading of 11.5 Lymphatic system of human, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-255.

blocks.text: Lymphatic system returns the excess fluid and dissolved proteins and other substances to blood. In an average person, about three litres more fluid leaves blood capillaries daily. But it is absorbed by lymphatic capillaries and returned to bloodstream, before the blood enters heart. Lymphatic system also helps to defend body against foreign invaders. Lymph nodes filter lymph. They have lymphocytes and macrophages that destroy bacteria and viruses present in lymph. Spleen filters blood through its macrophages and lymphocytes that destroy foreign particles and aged RBCs. Spleen also functions to store RBCs.
